generationOrder: Generate the 14K set first as the hero family, review, then 10K and 18K. Never recolor one set into another — every scene is composed independently (rules file: sameSceneRecolorAllowed = false).
creditDiscipline: One request = one generation, count always 1. No batch fan-out.

conceptNote.name: THE MERIDIAN
conceptNote.idea: The ring's whole identity is a single line where two materials meet. So the gallery is built on that line instead of on props: in every frame the composition contains one real boundary — a shadow edge, a horizon, a seam in stone, the fold of a sleeve, the lip of a table — and the ring's polished groove sits parallel to it or continues it. The ring stops being an object on a surface and becomes the punctuation of the frame.
conceptNote.whyItSells: Etsy jewelry galleries are almost entirely prop-led and interchangeable. A compositional signature is unmistakable at thumbnail size, survives being screenshotted into Pinterest, and reads as a brand rather than a dropshipper. It also does the selling work: the concept forces every frame to show the two finishes and the divider line, which is the only thing a buyer is actually choosing.
conceptNote.palette: Warm neutral grounds (bone, sand, clay, graphite). One cool accent only where it separates the white-gold half. No pastel, no seasonal color, no gradient backdrops.
conceptNote.light: One dominant soft source plus one controlled specular. The polished groove must read as a single clean highlight — it is the hero detail and must never be blown out.

etsyVisualLanguageCheck.thumbnailFirst: Etsy's search grid renders the first image small. Image 01 is composed so the ring occupies a large share of the frame with a hard tonal split behind it — legible at 170 px.
etsyVisualLanguageCheck.answerTheBuyingQuestions: Positions 04 (width ladder), 05 (profile/thickness) and 07 (spec card) exist to answer width, thickness and fit before the buyer asks. These reduce pre-purchase messages and post-purchase returns.
etsyVisualLanguageCheck.trustSignals: Positions 02, 06 and 08 carry real human skin — the rules file requires at least 3. Skin texture must be natural and unretouched; over-smoothed hands read as stock and cost trust.
etsyVisualLanguageCheck.allTenUsed: Etsy allows 10 images and listings that fill all 10 convert better. Every slot has a distinct job; none is filler.
clichesBanned: ring on mossy rock or tree bark with heavy bokeh
ring box with scattered rose petals or confetti
floating ring on pure white with a fake drop shadow
bridal bouquet with a fresh manicure
ring balanced on the pages of an open book
glitter, sparkle overlays or rainbow lens flare
beach sand, seashells and sunset backlight
ring on a mirror with a symmetrical reflection

output.exportMethod: Direct 2048 px square generation converted to 2048 px RGB JPEG at quality 92. No resizing.

hardRules.metadataStrippedOnExport: Higgsfield writes a tEXt hf-job-id chunk. Strip origin metadata at every outbound point (Etsy upload action and download proxy). Pixel-embedded SynthID is NOT metadata and cannot be removed — never promise a 'fully clean' file.

geometryReference.source: Owner-supplied photographs of the physical sample (5 frames). Upload pending — generate only once these are confirmed media ids.
geometryReference.description: Closed comfort-fit band, flat outer face, uniform 1.5 mm wall. The circumference is split lengthwise into two equal halves: one half soft brushed/satin white gold with fine parallel grain, the other half finely sandblasted matte yellow gold with an even micro-pitted texture. A single narrow polished yellow gold groove sits exactly on the boundary and runs the full 360 degrees. The interior is polished and domed for comfort fit. No stones, no inlay seam, no plating line.
mustNotInvent: a second groove or any additional divider line
a raised or stepped edge where the finishes meet — the transition is flush
milgrain beading, hammering or engraving of any kind
a rose gold tone; the two tones are yellow and white only
a wider or domed profile; the wall stays a slim flat 1.5 mm

scenes.job: Win the search grid at 170 px.
scenes.prompt: Single two-tone gold wedding band standing upright and filling most of a square frame, photographed dead-on. The background is split into two flat tonal fields — warm bone above, deep graphite below — and the horizon between them passes exactly through the ring's polished groove so the divider line of the background and the divider line of the ring read as one continuous meridian. One soft key from the upper left puts a single clean specular highlight along the polished groove. The brushed white-gold half and the sandblasted matte yellow-gold half are both clearly legible. No props, no text, no reflection on the ground.

scenes.job: Scale and trust, immediately after the hero.
scenes.prompt: Adult hand resting palm-down on a warm clay-toned plaster ledge in late-afternoon window light, wearing the two-tone band on the ring finger. A hard-edged shadow from a window frame crosses the surface and the hand, and the ring sits precisely where the shadow edge falls so the light-dark boundary lines up with the ring's polished groove. Natural unretouched skin texture, visible knuckle and pore detail, short unpainted nails. The band encircles exactly one finger. No jewelry other than this ring.

scenes.job: Show the only thing the buyer is really choosing.
scenes.prompt: Extreme macro across the boundary of a two-tone gold band, the surface filling the entire frame. On one side, fine parallel brushed grain in white gold catching light as soft directional streaks. On the other, evenly sandblasted matte yellow gold with dense micro-pitted texture that scatters light with no shine. Between them a narrow polished yellow-gold groove running edge to edge as a single mirror-bright hairline. Raking light from the left to maximise texture separation. Shallow depth of field falling off at the frame edges. No props, no hand, no background visible.

scenes.job: Answer 'which width?' before it is asked.
scenes.prompt: Four identical two-tone gold wedding bands of increasing width — 4 mm, 5 mm, 6 mm and 7 mm — standing upright in a precise row on a bone-coloured stone ledge, photographed straight on at true relative proportion so the width difference is unmistakable. Each ring shows the brushed white-gold half, the sandblasted yellow-gold half and the single polished groove, and all four grooves align on one horizontal line running across the frame. Even soft light, one gentle shared shadow beneath. No text, no numbers, no props.

Pure side profile of a two-tone gold wedding band lying on its edge on a dark graphite surface, lit from behind and slightly above so the slim 1.5 mm wall is silhouetted crisply against a lighter background gradient. The flat outer face is square to camera, the polished comfort-fit interior curve just catching a soft rim light. The polished groove reads as one crisp bright line running around the visible circumference. Minimal, architectural, no props.

scenes.job: Couple context without the bridal cliché.
scenes.prompt: Two adult hands of different skin tones resting side by side on the edge of a raw oak table, each wearing a two-tone gold band at a different width, photographed from directly above. The straight edge of the table runs through the frame and both rings sit just above it so the table edge and the rings' polished grooves form parallel lines. Warm indirect daylight, relaxed unposed fingers, natural skin texture with visible hair and pores. No bouquet, no rings touching, no wedding styling.

scenes.job: Etsy best practice: one designed information card, not clip-art.
scenes.prompt: Editorial specification card on a flat bone-coloured ground. A single two-tone gold band sits in the lower right, and thin precise hairlines extend from the ring to short typeset labels set in a restrained modern serif: 'WIDTH 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 mm', 'THICKNESS 1.5 mm', 'US 3 - 13 incl. half sizes', 'SOLID GOLD, TWO TONE', 'COMFORT FIT'. Typography is small, generous in spacing, dark warm grey, aligned to a strict left margin. No icons, no badges, no drop shadows, no coloured banners. The layout should feel like a design specimen sheet, not a sale graphic.
scenes.textAccuracyGate: Every number in this frame must match the listing exactly. Re-read the rendered text before upload — a wrong width or size range here is a false claim, not a typo.

scenes.job: Believable scale in a human hand.
scenes.prompt: A two-tone gold band held upright between thumb and index fingertip against a soft sand-toned background, the ring in sharp focus and the fingertips slightly softer. Fingerprint ridges and natural skin texture clearly visible to establish true scale. The ring is turned so the polished groove runs vertically and divides the frame, brushed white gold on one side and sandblasted yellow gold on the other. Single soft key light from the right, no other props.

scenes.job: Sell the optional engraving without promising a specific text.
scenes.prompt: A two-tone gold band tilted to reveal the polished comfort-fit interior, resting at an angle on a folded charcoal linen cloth whose crisp fold line runs beneath the ring and continues the direction of the ring's groove. A short discreet inside engraving in a fine serif is just legible on the inner wall. The domed interior catches a soft reflected highlight that shows the comfort-fit curve. Quiet, intimate lighting, no props beyond the cloth.

scenes.job: Brand image — the frame people screenshot.
scenes.prompt: Quiet editorial still life: a two-tone gold band leaning upright against a smooth hand-blown amber glass form on a clay-coloured plaster surface, photographed in low raking afternoon light. The glass casts a long soft-edged shadow whose straight boundary runs across the frame and passes through the ring's polished groove. The glass is smooth and molded with no facets and no gem-like cuts. Restrained, architectural, generous negative space in the upper half. No flowers, no fabric, no additional objects.

beforeUpload: All 10 native 2048x2048, RGB JPEG, no mechanical upscale.
10 distinct sha256 hashes — no recolored duplicates.
At least 3 scenes with real human skin (positions 2, 6, 8).
Every ring a closed continuous loop; worn views encircle exactly one finger.
Two tones are yellow and white only; exactly one polished groove; flush transition.
Profile stays a slim flat 1.5 mm wall — no domed or chunky band.
No gemstone, crystal or faceted prop anywhere in the set.
Position 07: every rendered number matches the listing exactly.
Origin metadata stripped at the outbound point.
qaGate.finalArbiter: A real render viewed at full size. 'The prompt says so' is not evidence.
